issues: Pre-existing font-glyph issue outside current review scope: the Direção column uses Unicode arrows '↑' / '↓' at /app/frontend/src/lib/pdf.js:208 which Helvetica does NOT support, so cells render as garbled '!" A perder' and '!' A ganhar' with per-character CID artifacts. Same class of bug as the Σ/Δ issue just fixed. Suggested fix: replace ↑/↓ with plain text ('▲ A ganhar' → 'A ganhar (subir)' or similar) OR register a Unicode TTF via doc.addFileToVFS / doc.addFont.

'EVOLUÇÃO' section heading and internal chart title 'Peso (kg)' are now on separate lines but still visually close (~4pt gap + underline). Not overlapping (fix applied and validated), but if the designer wants tighter aesthetic, the internal per-chart 'Peso (kg)' / '% MG · Reilly & Wallace' titles are somewhat redundant with the section heading.
